edges.caveat: Separate legal identity; no affiliation shown in reviewed official profile.
Reward quantity, inventory source and net spot demand unknown.
This addendum does not quantify or revise the Circle-Coinbase agreement.

hypotheses.claim: The SBIC reference is to SBIC East Japan rather than SBI Holdings.
hypotheses.disconfirming: A separate source explicitly linking SBIC East Japan to SBI Holdings would change this classification.
hypotheses.implication: Do not transfer SBI Group XRP relationships to SBIC East Japan.

hypotheses.claim: The phrase ChatGPT SBIC refers to an SBIC-hosted educational event/training context.
hypotheses.disconfirming: No OpenAI partnership or investment evidence in these event records.
hypotheses.implication: Classify as education, not corporate collaboration.

hypotheses.claim: SBI VC Trade provides a Japanese RLUSD distribution route through its VCTRADE service.
hypotheses.disconfirming: Actual volume, settlement use and XRP collateral balances are not disclosed.
hypotheses.implication: Infrastructure/access edge only; no XRP demand inference.

hypotheses.claim: SBI's Visa-linked credit card creates a retail XRP reward-distribution channel.
hypotheses.disconfirming: No reward inventory source, quantity, redemption rate or customer uptake disclosed.
hypotheses.implication: Track as distribution, not confirmed spot buying.

hypotheses.claim: The ETF flow sign conflict is materially affected by issuer-file dates, prior-session alignment and provider capture time.
hypotheses.disconfirming: No raw issuer-file crosswalk has yet resolved the discrepancies.
hypotheses.implication: Do not average or admit daily flow to model.

hypotheses.claim: Different fund universes and missing-fund policies explain part of aggregate disagreement.
hypotheses.disconfirming: Universe mismatch alone does not explain the XRPC sign conflict.
hypotheses.implication: Store per-fund coverage and missingness; never fill missing as zero.

minority_objections: The three ETF providers may share upstream issuer files, so they are not independent confirmations.
The latest CryptoKeyhole aggregate is not necessarily more accurate merely because its page timestamp is later; its issuer-file date mapping contains an apparent timestamp inconsistency.
SBI's RLUSD listing may increase RLUSD accessibility without increasing native XRP use or demand.
XRP rewards may be sourced from existing inventory or treasury holdings rather than open-market purchases.
